# Containment Tenure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ContainmentTenure`](gmeow-ContainmentTenure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ContainmentTenure>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reified, time-scoped fact that a place was contained in a larger place over an interval — for boundary changes, re-organisations, and disputed parallel parents. Reifies [`containedInPlace`](../properties/gmeow-containedInPlace.md) over time; the plain transitive property remains the flat shortcut.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to reify time-scoped place-in-place containment for boundary changes, re-organisations, or disputed parallel parents.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the simple, current case (use flat [`gmeow:containedInPlace`](../properties/gmeow-containedInPlace.md)) and avoid deleting an expired containment — keep it with [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### How to use

- Mint [`ContainmentTenure`](gmeow-ContainmentTenure.md), set [`gmeow:containmentChild`](../properties/gmeow-containmentChild.md) / [`gmeow:containmentParent`](../properties/gmeow-containmentParent.md), and scope with [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md).

### Examples

- ex:ct a [`gmeow:ContainmentTenure`](gmeow-ContainmentTenure.md); [`gmeow:containmentChild`](../properties/gmeow-containmentChild.md) ex:cityX; [`gmeow:containmentParent`](../properties/gmeow-containmentParent.md) ex:countyOld; [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md) ex:pre1974.
